final.observation: Reconciled three instrument nodes for event slac-003. The candidate RF station KLYS:LI21:81:AMPL shows a modest ~2.9% peak deviation from baseline but its data is extremely sparse (98.7% no-update fraction, only 11 finite samples of 821), leaving waveform behavior around the event largely unobservable. All eight BPM channels across LTU (BPMS:LTUH:250 TMIT/X, BPMS:LTUH:450 TMIT/X) and dump (BPMS:DMPH:502 TMIT/Y, BPMS:DMPH:693 TMIT/Y) show only mild, transient, non-sustained z-score elevations (peak robust z 2.24–4.43, longest_consecutive_samples = 0 for every channel), with null onset times and disturbance_detected = false on both BPM instruments. There is no aligned beam onset to time-correlate with the RF excursion.
